## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)).

## Affected area

- FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL

## Related issues

https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/issues/1915

## Summary

Fixes a regression introduced by c5e02afd where adding thd_excluded_d_shapes to Capabilities changed the append-order contract pinned by SDPA FROST tests.

The new field was appended after pack_gqa_requires_divisible, which shifted Capabilities[-6:] and broke:

test/python/sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bias_sm107.py::test_template_params_and_capabilities_are_appended

This patch moves thd_excluded_d_shapes to immediately after dense_only_d_shapes, before the resident-bias / kv-mask append-order pins, preserving the existing Capabilities[-6:] contract.

## Root Cause

test_template_params_and_capabilities_are_appended intentionally pins the tail ordering of Capabilities:

bias_d_shapes
bias_io_dtype_only
kv_mask
kv_mask_dtypes
tile_ns_by_d_shape
pack_gqa_requires_divisible

c5e02afd added thd_excluded_d_shapes after pack_gqa_requires_divisible, so the dataclass tail became:

bias_io_dtype_only
kv_mask
kv_mask_dtypes
tile_ns_by_d_shape
pack_gqa_requires_divisible
thd_excluded_d_shapes

That violated the append-order pin even though the new capability itself is valid.

## Fix

Move thd_excluded_d_shapes earlier in the dataclass:

dense_only_d_shapes
thd_excluded_d_shapes
bias_d_shapes
bias_io_dtype_only
kv_mask
kv_mask_dtypes
tile_ns_by_d_shape
pack_gqa_requires_divisible

This keeps the new native dense-Q-only capability while preserving the resident-bias / kv-mask tail ordering contract.

## Validation

Ran full target pytest file on local testers:

- B100: 92 passed, 49 skipped
- A100: 92 passed, 49 skipped

Command shape:

python3 -m pytest -m L0 --tb=short -ra sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_bias_sm107.py
